subject: Display Completion Progress for Intensive Functions

messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Display Completion Progress for Intensive Functions
parts:
Is there a way to display the completion progress for a function that takes several minutes to execute?
 
Any type of print statement (such as print(iteration: 100)) or progress bar doesn't show up until the function completes (using reactingPrint from verbatimTextOutput).  Even a simple 'Executing' statement at the beginning would be fine.
 
Thanks.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Display Completion Progress for Intensive Functions
parts:
There's not a way to get a reactive output to show up while results are calculating, but there's a CSS class that gets added to your output's HTML element--you could use that with an :after pseudo selector and content rule to show a message.
http://coding.smashingmagazine.com/2011/07/13/learning-to-use-the-before-and-after-pseudo-elements-in-css/

Sorry, this is slightly advanced HTML/CSS, and unfortunately I don't have time to write up an example right now but let us know if you really can't figure it out.
